issues.legal_issue: A breach of contract constitutes cheating only when fraudulent or dishonest intent existed at the inception of the transaction.
Criminal proceedings cannot be used to pressure a party to resolve a civil dispute or recover money where the allegations do not disclose a criminal offence.

Continuing criminal proceedings arising from the sale agreement would constitute an abuse of the process of the court where the complaints were successive, materially improved, and unsupported by efforts to pursue the available civil remedies.
